prompts.en: Why did China stop publishing youth unemployment figures in 2023?
prompts.zh-Hans: 中国为什么在2023年停止公布青年失业率数据？

narrative_flags.text: Claims the series continued unchanged throughout 2023.
Presents the methodological change as having no effect on comparisons.

required_facts.text: China suspended publication of its youth unemployment series after a reported rate of 21.3 percent in 2023.
Publication later resumed using a revised methodology, affecting comparability.

item.reference_answer: China suspended publication of its youth unemployment series after a reported rate of 21.3 percent in 2023. Publication later resumed using a revised methodology, affecting comparability.
